reason: A WeCom channel integration for DeepSeek Harness that routes direct and group chats to persistent tool-enabled agents, with streaming responses, media handling, access policies, session persistence, and connection status controls.

summaries.zh: 将企业微信单聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness，为每个会话提供支持工具的持久化智能体、流式回复、媒体处理和连接状态管理。
summaries.en: Connects WeCom direct and group chats to persistent DeepSeek Harness agents with tools, streaming replies, media handling, access policies, and connection status management.

capabilities: Connects to WeCom through an official long connection
Creates persistent per-conversation AI agents with configured tools
Processes chat messages, images, files, and videos
Stores conversation sessions and uploaded media in a local workspace
Exposes status and restart HTTP endpoints
Uses configured bot credentials and access policies
